title: Don’t download this trash
body: Seems great at first, until you find out it’s actually a free week trial and then it’s payed. Yup, an app to put check marks in boxes asks you for money, without any notice at the start. Money grubbing scammers.
author: Uncle_Dewey

title: Complete waste of my time
body: I thought it was a great app, very useful for tracking dates the exact way I wanted. But it turns out there’s a free trial, and when it ends, you’re basically unable to do ANYTHING without paying. I can’t even copy the notes I had written down to a different place, because clicking on anything brings up the paid plan pop-up. Deleted.
